area: Cottonwood Road & East Pacheco Road, east Bakersfield
summary: Grass fire burning in a field at Cottonwood and East Pacheco. Multiple engines and patrol units staged a flank attack from two sides and reported the spread stopped shortly before 4:45 a.m.

area: westbound Highway 58, east of Broome Avenue
summary: A big rig jackknifed and struck the center divider on westbound Highway 58. A trauma activation was called for a person with possible long-bone fractures; ambulances responded.
Caller reported a female believed to be held against her will by a male subject at a motel on South Union Avenue. Officers responded to check on her welfare.
Hotel security watched a female try to flee a room while a male subject pulled her back inside. Officers were dispatched to the scene.
A passerby reported a transient male assaulting a business employee. Officers responded to the location.
Emergency crews responded to a woman in labor at the Lakeside Apartments. Dispatchers reported the baby appeared to be born before medics arrived; a second ambulance was requested.
Medical aid dispatched for a reported overdose on Butte Street.
Officers checked the welfare of a woman reported to have cut herself after a dispute with her boyfriend. Officers asked her father to have her step out to meet them.
Welfare check on a suicidal subject reported to have expressed suicidal ideation at a bus terminal.
A man in his 30s was found slumped over on the floor near a motel room; officers and medical units responded.
Multi-vehicle crash; all occupants were reported out of the vehicles when a medic unit arrived on scene.
A white four-door struck a curb; witnesses said occupants fled on foot. The vehicle was left behind and officers investigated.
Outside fire reported at a dumpster near a market at Panama Lane and Wible Road.
Medical aid for difficulty breathing on Cave Avenue.
Engine responded to Victor Street for a person experiencing a seizure.
Exterior trash pile fire near Chester Avenue; truck unit investigated and handled it.
Report of an oven fire; engine and truck units responded.
